_comment: R2880 sub7 — pre-rendered opening prologue narration page (512x512 PSMT4, pixel blob at file offset 1962944, 131072 bytes, bg index 15, ink index 0). PER-WINDOW SLOT model (v93): the cinematic samples each subtitle ROW i through 1-3 FIXED UV-X windows (texelX ranges on a 24px grid, uvY band = i*24..i*24+24); 5 rows (i=0,3,4,14,16) are SPLIT into 2 windows with a 24px BLANK dead-zone between them (the JP full-width-space phrase gap). English authored as one continuous run spills into the dead-zone and is dropped on screen (the v92 'kingdom's people to t[CUT]' / '-thirds would' bug). FIX: each line has a 'windows' list ([x0,x1] texels) and a 'segs' list (one English segment per window); patch_r2880.py draws seg[k] left-aligned at windows[k][0]+left_pad and HARD-ASSERTS its ink width <= window width, leaving every dead-zone blank. Windows measured live from GS dumps via build/recon_v86/gs-vram-atlas/gs_atlas.py (recon_fvs/intro_fmv). English follows the guide prologue (data/guide_full_text.txt) with the v85 narration names (Kingdom of Duhan, Battle of Banquo, San-Goth, Venoa, Ortrud the Holy King).

lines.jp: かつて　三十年もの長きにわたって
ドゥーハン王国を血と恐怖に
segs: the Kingdom of Duhan was plunged

lines.jp: 王国の人口を　三分の二までに減少させた
その悲惨な戦争は　バンクォーの戦役と
サンゴート王が獣人を率い、
そもそもの発端であったが、
segs: that was how it all began,

lines.jp: 戦火はベノア全土に広がった。
segs: but war engulfed all of Venoa.

lines.jp: 一人の英雄が現れなければ、
地上から消えていたであろう。
後に聖王と呼ばれる　オルトルードである。
彼はサンゴートを打ち破り、
ドゥーハン王国に　平和と希望を取り戻した。
segs: peace and hope to the Kingdom.
